description: DevOps rules for containerization, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, and deployment practices

rules.description: Run containers as non-root user for security
rules.message: Container must run as non-root user. Add 'USER nonroot' or 'USER 1000'
rules.design_check: Does the deployment design specify running containers as non-root users? Ensure Dockerfiles include a USER directive with a non-root user. Flag if missing.

rules.description: Avoid using :latest tag in base images
rules.message: Use specific version tags instead of :latest for reproducible builds
rules.design_check: Does the design reference container images? Ensure specific version tags are used (e.g., node:20.11-alpine) not :latest. Flag :latest usage.

rules.description: Clean apt cache after installing packages
rules.message: Add '&& rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*' after apt-get install to reduce image size

rules.description: Containers should not run in privileged mode
rules.message: Container must not run in privileged mode
rules.design_check: Does the design specify privileged containers? Deny unless there is an explicitly documented and approved need. BLOCK.

rules.description: Pods should not use host network
rules.message: Pod should not use host network unless absolutely necessary
rules.design_check: Does the design use host networking for pods? Deny unless explicitly justified. BLOCK.

rules.description: Secrets should not be hardcoded in workflows
rules.message: Do not hardcode secrets. Use GitHub Secrets or environment variables
rules.design_check: Does the CI/CD design reference secrets or credentials? Ensure all are injected via GitHub Secrets, vault, or env var injection — never hardcoded in pipeline files. BLOCK on hardcoded secrets.

rules.description: Avoid mutable tags like latest in production
rules.message: Do not use :latest tag in production. Use immutable version tags
rules.design_check: Does the production deployment design use :latest image tags? Replace with SHA-pinned or semantic version tags for reproducibility. BLOCK in production contexts.

rules.description: Secrets must not be baked into container images
rules.message: Do not bake secrets into images. Use runtime secret injection
rules.design_check: Does the design bake secrets into container images (via ENV instructions with actual values)? Replace with runtime injection via secrets manager or environment vars at deployment time. BLOCK.

rules.message: Avoid environment-specific logic in code. Use config instead
rules.design_check: Does the design include environment-specific branching in application code (if prod / if staging)? Replace with configuration-driven behavior. Flag for discussion.

rules.description: Use environment variables for all ports and hosts
rules.message: Use environment variables for ports and hosts instead of hardcoding (e.g., process.env.PORT, process.env.HOST). Apply to all services including Node.js services.
rules.design_check: Does the design hardcode ports or hostnames? All ports and hosts should come from environment variables. Flag any hardcoded values.

rules.message: Do not hardcode configuration values. Use environment variables from .env file
rules.design_check: Does the design specify configuration values inline? All configuration (URLs, hosts, ports, feature flags) must come from environment variables. BLOCK on hardcoded config.

rules.description: Avoid mutable config in running pods
rules.message: Do not mutate config in running pods

rules.description: Production deployments must go through pipeline
rules.message: Do not deploy directly to production clusters
rules.design_check: Does the deployment design include any direct kubectl apply or helm upgrade commands to production outside of a CI/CD pipeline? If so, route through pipeline with approval gates. BLOCK.
